name: Teacher creates a group and gets a QR code for students
description: Verifies a teacher can create a group and lands on a working panel with a QR code that survives a reload.
steps: Type 'ИВТ-21' into 'Название группы' and '+7 999 123-45-67' into 'Ваш телефон для SMS'
expected: The teacher panel shows the title 'ИВТ-21', a QR code, a student link containing '#/s/', the text 'Тревог нет — всё спокойно.' and 'Пока никто не подключился', both before and after the refresh.

name: Student registers via the group link and appears in the teacher list
description: Verifies a student who opens the QR link and registers shows up live in the teacher's list with their phone number.
setup: Actor A creates a group named 'ИВТ-21' with phone '+7 999 123-45-67' and keeps the teacher panel open
steps: Actor B opens the student link shown on Actor A's panel (the address ending with '#/s/' plus the group code)
Actor B types 'Иванов Иван' into 'Фамилия и имя' and '+7 912 345-67-89' into 'Твой телефон'
Actor A looks at the 'Студенты' section without reloading
expected: Actor B sees a large SOS button and the name 'Иванов Иван'. Actor A's 'Студенты' list shows 'Иванов Иван' with the phone '+7 912 345-67-89'.

name: SOS alert reaches the teacher panel and the teacher responds
description: Verifies an SOS from a student appears on the teacher panel with name and phone, and the student sees the teacher's response.
setup: Actor A creates a group named 'ИВТ-21' with phone '+7 999 123-45-67' and keeps the teacher panel open
Actor B opens the student link and registers as 'Иванов Иван' with phone '+7 912 345-67-89'
steps: Actor B taps the SOS button
Actor A clicks 'Принял, иду' on the new alert card
Actor A clicks 'Закрыть тревогу' on the same card
expected: After the SOS, Actor B sees 'Тревога отправлена' and Actor A sees an alert card with 'Иванов Иван', '+7 912 345-67-89' and 'Нужна помощь'. After 'Принял, иду' Actor B sees 'Преподаватель увидел тревогу и идёт к тебе'. After closing, Actor B sees 'Тревога закрыта' and the alert moves to the 'Журнал' section on Actor A's panel.

name: Student cancels an alert and teacher removes a student with confirmation
description: Verifies a cancelled alert lands in the teacher's history and a confirmed student removal stays removed after reload.
setup: Actor A creates a group named 'ИВТ-21' with phone '+7 999 123-45-67' and keeps the teacher panel open
Actor B opens the student link and registers as 'Петрова Анна' with phone '+7 900 111-22-33'
Actor B taps the SOS button
steps: Actor B clicks 'Отменить — всё в порядке' and confirms the dialog
Actor A clicks the remove button next to 'Петрова Анна' in the 'Студенты' list and confirms the dialog
expected: Actor B sees 'Тревога отменена'. Actor A's 'Журнал' shows 'Петрова Анна — отменена студентом', and after the refresh 'Петрова Анна' is no longer in the 'Студенты' list.

name: Required fields are validated
covers: required name and phone validation for student registration
description: Verifies empty forms are rejected with visible messages and nothing is created.
steps: Open the app home page and click 'Создать группу'
Leave 'Ваш телефон для SMS' empty and click the 'Создать группу' button
Fill '+7 999 123-45-67' as the phone, create the group, open the student link from the panel
On the student page leave both fields empty and click 'Готово'
expected: The group form shows a message starting with 'Укажите номер телефона' and stays on the form; the student form shows 'Напиши фамилию и имя.' and no SOS button appears.
